text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘Water is Life’ (पानी ही जीवन है)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘Water is Life’ (Paani hi jeevan hai). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘Water is Life’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘need’ मतलब ज़रूरत। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘need’ matlab zaroorat. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘need’ means ज़रूरत. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘waste’ मतलब बरबाद करना। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘waste’ matlab barbaad karna. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘waste’ means बरबाद करना. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘drop’ मतलब बूँद। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘drop’ matlab boond. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘drop’ means बूँद. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: We drink water when we are thirsty.
We use water to cook, to wash and to clean.
Plants need water to grow, and animals need water too.
But many people do not have clean water.
So we should never waste it.
Close the tap when you brush your teeth.
Every drop of water is important.

question.hi: पौधों को बढ़ने के लिए क्या चाहिए?
question.hinglish: Paudhon ko badhne ke liye kya chahiye?
question.en: What do plants need to grow?

question.hi: दाँत साफ़ करते समय क्या करना चाहिए?
question.hinglish: Daant saaf karte samay kya karna chahiye?
question.en: What should you do when you brush your teeth?
